verdict.rationale: Managed model inference is a fair question for a hyperscale cloud platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents first-party managed inference over frontier or open models, or an inference API. The only AI-related item is Azure Copilot generating Terraform configurations, which is an adjacent assistant feature, not a model-serving platform service.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, models are a platform service — first-party managed inference over frontier and open models with a documented API
